      • createCustomAgent

        public CompletableFuture<CreateCustomAgentResponse> createCustomAgent(CreateCustomAgentRequest request)
        description :

        Before you call this operation, prepare a writable workspace, a RAM role ARN, a container image or code package, and runtime configurations. You must specify name, artifact, roleArn, and runtime. The runtime parameter must include both compute and sessionPolicy. In container mode, use artifact.container and specify artifact.port. The image must have the required access permissions and be accessible over the network allowed by the workspace. In code package pattern, specify artifact.port, and the sourceUri, languageRuntime, and entrypoint of artifact.code. Do not specify container at the same time. Dependencies must be packaged by the user. ZIP and TAR.GZ formats are supported. The compressed package size cannot exceed 500,000,000 bytes. You can call ListAgentCodeRuntimes to query the runtime environment identity. The sourceUri parameter supports oss:// addresses or HTTPS object addresses of standard OSS public domain names, including signed URLs. For local files, call GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl to obtain an upload URL, upload the file directly, and then commit the returned sourceUri. When you submit a new code package source, the backend rechecks the read permissions, object, and size. The configuration is saved only after the transfer succeeds. If the transfer fails, the configuration is not saved. Saved fixed packages can be reused. Set the client timeout to 210 seconds for code package requests. Archive integrity and secure decompression are checked at startup. A successful acceptance does not mean that the agent is ready to run. The creation process is asynchronous. A successful response indicates that the request is accepted. You can use the returned agentId to call GetCustomAgent and check the latestVersionStatus, latestExecutionError, and status corresponding to latestSpecVersion to confirm the deployment result. After the deployment is ready, you can call CreateServiceEndpoint to configure the access endpoint. The clientToken parameter does not provide idempotency guarantees. Do not rely on this parameter to prevent duplicate requests. The healthyThreshold parameter for health checks does not take effect. Omit this parameter.

        指定者:
        createCustomAgent 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of CreateCustomAgent CreateCustomAgentRequest
        返回:
        CreateCustomAgentResponse

      • createIdentityProvider

        public CompletableFuture<CreateIdentityProviderResponse> createIdentityProvider(CreateIdentityProviderRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        The WAITING_CONFIGURATION status also occupies the single external identity source quota for a workspace. CustomSSO (SAML/OIDC and SCIM) is mutually exclusive with DingTalk and Lark. SCIM reuses the CustomSSO binding and does not create a second identity source. Creating another type returns a 409 IdentityProviderAlreadyBound error. You can change the identity source only after the existing binding is unbound and removed. A workspace can have only one external identity source binding. The identityProviderType parameter supports DingTalk, Lark, and CustomSSO. CustomSSO only initializes the shared user pool. Do not pass non-empty metadata, and do not pass true for loginEnabled or syncEnabled. Both switches are disabled by default. Protocols and SAML configurations are saved by using UpdateIdentityProvider. SCIM is configured by using a separate API operation. You do not need to save SAML configurations first. If initialization is complete but SAML metadata is not saved, the system returns WAITING_CONFIGURATION. CONFIGURED and SYNCING indicate that the resource is still being initialized. You can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status. After you save the metadata, the system returns UPDATING. After the configuration is complete and the internal OIDC is published, the system returns READY. READY does not mean that the logon switch is enabled. For the same CustomSSO binding, the system may return the existing binding after the initialization request is accepted or completed. You cannot treat all statuses as repeatable creations. For DingTalk, the metadata must include appKey, appSecret, and corpId. For Lark, the metadata must include appId and appSecret. The vendor logon switch is enabled by default, and the synchronization switch is disabled by default. If synchronization is enabled, encryptKey and verificationToken are also required. The vendor syncOnBind and syncScope parameters retain the existing department-based synchronization definitions. Do not use these vendor pull parameters to replace SCIM configurations during CustomSSO initialization.

        Requests and examples

        POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/identity-providers Call conventions: Call the API operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. In the following examples, ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example shows the body parameters of the public API operation, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API operation. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        POST /workspaces/ws-example/identity-providers
 {"identityProviderType": "CustomSSO"}

        Response examples

        {
   "data": {
     "workspaceId": "ws-example",
     "identityProviderType": "CustomSSO",
     "loginEnabled": false,
     "syncEnabled": false,
     "status": "WAITING_CONFIGURATION"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: A 400 InvalidParameter error indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. A 404 IdentityProviderNotFound error indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. If a synchronous call to the upstream service fails, a 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable error may be returned. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling process. 409 IdentityProviderAlreadyBound: An external binding already exists. Query and reuse the correct binding first. Do not automatically unbind the entire binding. If the initialization request fails, retain the request ID for troubleshooting. If a binding already exists, query the current status first to avoid repeated creation.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        CustomSSO call sequence: Create the binding first. After initialization is complete, the system returns WAITING_CONFIGURATION. If the system returns CONFIGURED or SYNCING, you can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status. Then, you can configure SAML and SCIM separately. You do not need to complete them in a fixed sequence. For SAML, use GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider to obtain the SP information of your side, and use UpdateIdentityProvider to save the external IdP configuration. For SCIM, use PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM to obtain the pre-provisioning address and credentials, and then use UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM to confirm synchronization.

        指定者:
        createIdentityProvider 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of CreateIdentityProvider CreateIdentityProviderRequest
        返回:
        CreateIdentityProviderResponse

      • createIdentityProviderSCIMCredential

        public CompletableFuture<CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialResponse> createIdentityProviderSCIMCredential(CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        Issues a new credential explicitly. This requires an available shared pool and the AgentIdentity SCIM reception to be Enabled. This operation does not automatically enable reception. If it is not enabled, call prepare first. Returns the configuration, credential summary, and the current token. The limit of a maximum of two credentials is enforced by AgentIdentity. An existing available token does not prevent users from explicitly creating a second one. Old credentials are not automatically revoked, and no extended rotation process is provided. The token is returned only once and cannot be retrieved again in subsequent list and query operations. Do not automatically retry the issuance. If the response is lost, check the list first to verify whether it has been created. Creating a credential does not enable AC syncEnabled, start a full user import, or switch SAML logon. Deleting an old token should be performed explicitly after the user confirms the actual usage of the external provisioning system.

        Request and examples

        POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning/credentials Call conventions: Call the operation in the region of the target workspace, using an AK/STS identity that has permissions for the identity source resources of the corresponding workspace. The ws-example, URL, certificate, and token in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameter content of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Keep the requestId for troubleshooting and do not log the key. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        POST /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning/credentials
 No business request body.

        Response example

        {
   "data": {
     "configuration": {
       "status": "Enabled",
       "baseUrl": "https://example.com/scim/v2"
     },
     "credential": {
       "credentialId": "credential-example",
       "status": "Enabled",
       "expireTime": "<Upstream expiration time>"
     },
     "token": "<Newly issued token for the current request>"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that there is no binding of the matching type. Synchronous calls to the upstream may fail and return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Keep the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret read failures as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling. 400 LimitExceeded.ScimCredential: A maximum of two credentials are allowed. Delete one before you can continue to create. 400 InvalidParameter: Reception is not enabled or the shared pool is unavailable. Do not retry quota errors as system failures.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        After creation, securely save the token that is returned only once and configure it in the external provisioning system. Existing tokens remain valid. Only DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential revokes the specified credential. Do not automatically retry when the response is lost. Call ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials to check first. This operation does not provide automatic rotation or scaling.

        指定者:
        createIdentityProviderSCIMCredential 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialRequest
        返回:
        CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialResponse

      • createIdentityProviderSyncJob

        public CompletableFuture<CreateIdentityProviderSyncJobResponse> createIdentityProviderSyncJob(CreateIdentityProviderSyncJobRequest request)
        description :

        Initiates a one-time user synchronization based on the saved scope without saving the configuration or requiring syncEnabled=true. Prerequisites: the identity provider is in the READY or SYNC_FAILED state, a user pool exists, and no other pending identity provider operations are in progress. The returned taskId only indicates that the request is accepted. Call GetIdentityProviderSyncJob to poll the status until it reaches SUCCESS, FAILED, or CANCELED. If the task fails, check the failureReason. The workspace user quota still applies, and previously synchronized users are not automatically deleted if the scope is reduced. Authorization information: RAM action agentcore:CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob, access level Write, resource ARN: acs:agentcore:{regionId}:{accountId}:workspace/{workspaceId}/identityProvider/{identityProviderType}. This resource is required for authorization. Idempotency and retry: This operation does not provide a ClientToken parameter for conditional idempotency. Repeated submissions do not guarantee the same task is returned. If an operation is already in progress, an operation conflict is returned. Submitting again after the task ends creates a new synchronization task. If a submission times out, query the identity provider status first to avoid blindly resubmitting the request. Calling this API is free of charge, and operation records support ActionTrail auditing. Initial selective synchronization process: CreateIdentityProvider (syncOnBind=false, it is recommended to keep syncEnabled=false initially) → GetIdentityProvider and wait for READY → ListIdentityProviderDepartments to select departments → UpdateIdentityProvider to save syncScope and wait for READY → CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob → GetIdentityProviderSyncJob to query the terminal state. If incremental synchronization is required, configure callbacks and event subscriptions, and then update syncEnabled=true. Response example:

        {
   "requestId": "01234567-89AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF",
   "message": "success",
   "httpStatusCode": 200,
   "code": "SUCCESS",
   "success": true,
   "data": {
     "taskId": "12345678-1234-4234-8234-123456789abc",
     "status": "PENDING"
   }
 }
        指定者:
        createIdentityProviderSyncJob 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob CreateIdentityProviderSyncJobRequest
        返回:
        CreateIdentityProviderSyncJobResponse

      • createImageCache

        public CompletableFuture<CreateImageCacheResponse> createImageCache(CreateImageCacheRequest request)
        description :

        Creates or reuses an image cache in the current workspace based on the image source and tag. Both public and private images uniformly reuse the workspace\"s source image pull authorization and resource roles. The resource manager parses the tag during the transfer node and performs image replication based on the parsed summary. The digest is empty before parsing is complete. For regular tags, the saved summary is reused after parsing. For the latest tag, it is parsed again when registered after reaching the desired state, and duplicate registrations in progress reuse the node. The logical imageId remains stable. accessInternet and accessVpc only determine the source reading and transfer for the current request and do not modify the agent network. An HTTP 200 response returns an acceptance snapshot of PENDING, READY, or FAILED, which does not indicate that the creation is complete. ClientToken does not guarantee to deduplicate requests or recover the original result. If the result is unconfirmed, query the query cache status first before deciding whether to recommit.

      • deleteIdentityProvider

        public CompletableFuture<DeleteIdentityProviderResponse> deleteIdentityProvider(DeleteIdentityProviderRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        This operation disconnects the integration as a whole, rather than disabling logon individually. Disconnecting CustomSSO clears the users imported from this identity source, the remote shared user pool and related resources, and the logon publishing configurations and bindings. Therefore, both SAML and SCIM are affected. This operation does not delete the enterprise applications created by users on external platforms such as Azure. The system checks the references between users and teams before disconnecting. If references exist, the disconnection is rejected. After the request is accepted, the system returns DISCONNECTING. You can call GetIdentityProvider to query the status. The cleanup is complete only when the binding does not exist (IdentityProviderNotFound). The binding should also no longer appear in the list. DISCONNECT_FAILED indicates that partial cleanup may have occurred and the state cannot be restored to a brand new unconfigured state. You can retry based on the returned status. If the binding does not exist in the first place, the operation returns a placeholder result indicating no binding without creating new resources. An ongoing disconnection task may return the current binding. Do not use this operation as a substitute for setting loginEnabled=false, syncEnabled=false, or deleting a single token.

        Requests and examples

        DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/identity-providers/{identityProviderType} Calling conventions: Call this operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. In the following examples, ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example shows the body parameters of the public API operation, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API operation. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        DELETE /workspaces/ws-example/identity-providers/CustomSSO

        Response examples

        {
   "data": {
     "workspaceId": "ws-example",
     "identityProviderType": "CustomSSO",
     "status": "DISCONNECTING"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. Synchronous calls to the upstream may fail and return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret read failures as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling. 409 IdentityProvider.Disconnect.Conflict: Users of this identity source still belong to a team. Remove the references first. 409 IdentityProviderOperationConflict: The current status does not allow disconnection. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound: An external binding exists but the type does not match. Asynchronous failures may result in partial cleanup. You cannot claim completion based solely on the first response.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        If you only need to disable a specific capability: To disable SAML logon, set loginEnabled=false in UpdateIdentityProvider. To disable SCIM, set syncEnabled=false in UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM. To revoke a single token, use DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential. Call this operation only when you need to disconnect the integration as a whole.

        指定者:
        deleteIdentityProvider 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of DeleteIdentityProvider DeleteIdentityProviderRequest
        返回:
        DeleteIdentityProviderResponse

      • deleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential

        public CompletableFuture<DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialResponse> deleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential(DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        Revokes a specified credential. The credentialId parameter is required and cannot be empty. You can obtain it from the credential list. The shared pool must be available, but SAML configuration or SCIM accept being Enabled is not required. After deletion, external provisioning requests that use this token become invalid. This operation only affects the selected credential. It does not automatically disable the accept feature, does not automatically disable AC syncEnabled, and does not affect other credentials or SAML. Even if you delete the last credential, the synchronization switch is not automatically written back and a new token is not reissued. Disable external provisioning or replace the token in use as needed. A successful response returns a common response without business data. Refresh the list to confirm the deletion. The result for unknown or deleted IDs is determined by the upstream service. A unified 404 or unconditional idempotent success is not guaranteed.

        Request and examples

        DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning/credentials/{credentialId} Call conventions: Call the API in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey (AK) or Security Token Service (STS) identity that has permissions on the identity provider resources of the workspace. In the following examples, ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example shows the body parameters of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct-connect API. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Keep the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        DELETE /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning/credentials/credential-example

        Response example

        {
   "success": true,
   "httpStatusCode": 200
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. If a synchronous call to the upstream service fails, a 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable error may be returned. Keep the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow common error handling. 400 InvalidParameter: The credentialId parameter is empty or the shared pool is not available. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that the binding does not exist, which does not mean that all unknown credential IDs return this code. Handle other deletion errors based on upstream results. If the operation fails, refresh the list to check. No automatic creation of a replacement token is performed.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        Call ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials to obtain the credentialId and then delete the specified credential. If the external provisioning system still uses this token, subsequent provisioning may result in authentication failures. Therefore, confirm the actual usage first. After deletion, no automatic creation of a new credential is performed, and the AC synchronization switch or SAML logon is not disabled.

Concurrency is rechecked upon submission. Caches in the PENDING or FAILED state can still be deleted, and the backend handles the cleanup. An HTTP 200 response returns an imageId that matches the request. If deletionPending is true, the current workspace is still undergoing deletion, and a Get request returns DELETING until ImageCacheNotFound is explicitly returned. If false, the deletion is complete or the current workspace no longer exists. Usage by other workspaces does not block the deletion for the current workspace. The physical content is reclaimed only after all workspaces in the same region have removed their associations and no active instances are using it.

      • getIdentityProvider

        public CompletableFuture<GetIdentityProviderResponse> getIdentityProvider(GetIdentityProviderRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        Reads existing bindings by type. CustomSSO returns the saved protocol, normalized saml, expected loginEnabled, syncEnabled, and shared binding status. If SAML is not configured, saml and configuration may not be returned. If saml is configured, the system additionally queries AgentIdentity, and configuration represents the actual SSO configuration. The saml field is the data source for the edit form. The status switch for configuration is Enabled or Disabled. If the upstream query fails, an error is returned. The failure cannot be treated as an unconfigured state. Only this operation reads back the actual SAML configuration. List and write operations do not guarantee that configuration is returned. WAITING_CONFIGURATION indicates that user pool initialization is complete but the SAML metadata has not been saved. In this case, you can read the service provider (SP) information, fill in the configuration, or disconnect the integration. Do not lock the form and wait for the READY state. UPDATING and UPDATE_FAILED describe logon configuration tasks, not SCIM tasks. The vendor callback URL for CustomSSO is empty. Use GetIdentityProviderSCIM.operationStatus to query SCIM operation results.

        Requests and examples

        GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/identity-providers/{identityProviderType} Call conventions: Call the operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS credential that has permissions on the identity provider resources of the workspace. In the following examples, ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameters of the public API operation, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct-connection API operation. The response example shows only the business data. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Keep the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a persistent connection to wait for completion.

        GET /workspaces/ws-example/identity-providers/CustomSSO

        Response examples

        {
   "data": {
     "workspaceId": "ws-example",
     "identityProviderType": "CustomSSO",
     "status": "WAITING_CONFIGURATION",
     "loginEnabled": false,
     "syncEnabled": false
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. A synchronous call to the upstream service may fail and return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Keep the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as an unconfigured state. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow common error handling procedures. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound: No binding exists, or the input type is inconsistent with the current binding. If SAML is already configured, an upstream readback failure does not degrade to a successful empty configuration.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        SAML configuration completion and logon enabling are independent operations. protocol=SAML and the presence of the saml field indicate that the logon configuration has been submitted, and loginEnabled indicates the expected logon switch. Check the effective status based on the actual SSO status in configuration. SCIM uses an independent query operation. Do not use status=READY of this operation as the basis for successful SCIM synchronization. Currently, OIDC and JIT configurations or JIT status fields are not provided.

        指定者:
        getIdentityProvider 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of GetIdentityProvider GetIdentityProviderRequest
        返回:
        GetIdentityProviderResponse

      • getIdentityProviderSCIM

        public CompletableFuture<GetIdentityProviderSCIMResponse> getIdentityProviderSCIM(GetIdentityProviderSCIMRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        The shared CustomSSO user pool must be created and not in the process of overall unbinding or unbinding failure. Prior SAML configuration is not required. SAML updates or update failures do not block the query. configuration.status and baseUrl are retrieved from AgentIdentity. syncEnabled is the expected synchronization switch for AC. operationStatus represents the most recent independent SCIM switch and the initial full import task when enabled. The presence of a URL does not indicate that external provisioning is complete or that AC synchronization is enabled. operationStatus valid values:

        • PENDING: Waiting.
        • RUNNING: Executing.
        • PAUSED: Paused.
        • SUCCESS: Succeeded.
        • FAILED: Failed.
        • CANCELED: Canceled. If there are no historical tasks, it returns null or is not returned. You can poll when the status is PENDING or RUNNING. Stop polling when a terminal state is reached. You can manually refresh when the status is PAUSED. This operation does not provide the taskId or failure details, and does not indicate credential issuance, external provisioning connection tests, or continuous incremental synchronization health. The URL, credentials, and historical task records may be retained after the feature is disabled. status represents the independent SCIM configuration status:
        • UNCONFIGURED: Preparation is not complete.
        • WAITING_CONFIGURATION: The receiving end is enabled, the HTTPS URL is valid, and a valid token exists, waiting for external configuration and enablement confirmation.
        • UPDATING: The enablement or disablement task is executing.
        • READY: Synchronization is enabled and the current enablement task succeeded, and the receiving end, URL, and credentials are still available.
        • DISABLED: Disabled and configuration is retained.
        • UPDATE_FAILED: The operation failed, was paused, was canceled, or the configuration and credentials are unavailable after enablement. The original facts of configuration, syncEnabled, and operationStatus are retained. The SAML or OIDC binding status is not used to determine the SCIM status. READY does not prove that Matrix execution is complete, the external connection test passed, or continuous incremental synchronization is healthy.

        Requests and examples

        GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning Call conventions: Call this operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has the permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. The ws-example, URL, certificate, and token in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameters of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example only shows the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        GET /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning

        Response examples

        {
   "data": {
     "status": "READY",
     "configuration": {
       "status": "Enabled",
       "baseUrl": "https://example.com/scim/v2"
     },
     "syncEnabled": true,
     "operationStatus": "SUCCESS"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that there is no binding of the matching type. Synchronous calls to upstream services that fail may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret read failures as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling process. 400 InvalidParameter: The shared user pool is unavailable, being unbound, or failed to unbind. If there is no binding, 404 IdentityProviderNotFound is returned. Upstream read failures must retain the error and cannot be mapped to Disabled, unconfigured, or synchronization succeeded.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        SCIM configuration sequence: After preparing the shared pool, call PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM and configure the returned baseUrl and newly issued token to the provisioning system of the external IdP. After completing the external connection test, call UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM to enable synchronization, and then call this operation to query operationStatus. SUCCESS only indicates that the most recent SCIM task is complete, and does not represent continuous incremental synchronization health or the success of the external provisioning connection test.

        指定者:
        getIdentityProviderSCIM 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of GetIdentityProviderSCIM GetIdentityProviderSCIMRequest
        返回:
        GetIdentityProviderSCIMResponse

      • getIdentityProviderServiceProvider

        public CompletableFuture<GetIdentityProviderServiceProviderResponse> getIdentityProviderServiceProvider(GetIdentityProviderServiceProviderRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        An available CustomSSO shared user pool is required. The identityProviderType must be CustomSSO. The protocol parameter is required and only supports the exact value SAML. Uploading the IdP metadata in advance is not required. This operation returns the entityId, acsUrl, and metadataXml of the SP for configuring an external IdP. These values are not the logon URL or IdP entity ID of the external IdP. You cannot submit the SP XML as the IdP XML to UpdateIdentityProvider. This operation is read-only. It does not enable logon, enable SCIM, create credentials, or perform logon connection tests. You cannot read the information when the shared pool is being initialized, being unbound, or has failed to unbind.

        Requests and examples

        GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/identity-providers/{identityProviderType}/service-provider Call conventions: Call this operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. The ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example shows the body parameters of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Keep the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a persistent connection to wait for completion.

        GET /workspaces/ws-example/identity-providers/CustomSSO/service-provider?protocol=SAML

        Response examples

        {
   "data": {
     "protocol": "SAML",
     "entityId": "<SP entity ID>",
     "acsUrl": "https://example.com/saml/acs",
     "metadataXml": "<SP metadata XML>"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. Synchronous calls to upstream services that fail may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Keep the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow common error handling. 400 InvalidParameter: identityProviderType or protocol is not supported. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound: No CustomSSO binding exists. 409 IdentityProviderOperationConflict: The user pool is not ready, is being unbound, or has failed to unbind.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        SAML configuration sequence: Call CreateIdentityProvider to initialize the CustomSSO shared pool and wait for GetIdentityProvider to return READY. Call this operation to obtain the SP information and configure it in the external IdP. Then, submit the external IdP metadata XML or complete manual configuration to UpdateIdentityProvider. After saving, enable loginEnabled separately as needed. Querying the SP information does not complete the external IdP configuration or verify logon.

        指定者:
        getIdentityProviderServiceProvider 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider GetIdentityProviderServiceProviderRequest
        返回:

        description :

        Queries DingTalk or Lark departments by hierarchy and page. Prerequisites include an existing identity provider binding, a user pool, valid application credentials, and address book read authorization. If parentDepartmentId is not specified, the root hierarchy is queried. When expanding a node, use the ID of the node to query its direct child departments. The hasChildren field is used to determine expandability and does not indicate that child nodes have been returned. The nextToken field is only used to continue querying the next page under the current parent department. The query only reads the directory, does not save the synchronization scope, and does not import users. After a new department is added to a DingTalk or Lark organization, re-query the corresponding parent department because the old list does not represent the latest directory. Authorization information: The RAM operation is agentcore:ListIdentityProviderDepartments, the access level is List, and the resource ARN is acs:agentcore:{regionId}:{accountId}:workspace/{workspaceId}/identityProvider/{identityProviderType}.       • listIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials

        public CompletableFuture<ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialsResponse> listIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials(ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialsRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        Retrieves the current credential summary list from AgentIdentity and returns a data array. Each item contains credentialId, status, createTime, and expireTime. If no credentials exist, an empty array is returned. This operation does not support maxResults, nextToken, or pagination. Do not call this operation with fake pagination fields. The list never returns plaintext tokens, nor does it enable the receiving or issuing of new credentials. Receiving is not required to be enabled, but the shared pool must be available. A credential is considered available if its status is Enabled and its expireTime is later than the current time. The maximum limit of two credentials is determined by AgentIdentity. Client-side counting is for reference only. The list may contain unavailable or expired credentials. Do not use this list to claim that available tokens exist.

        Requests and examples

        GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning/credentials Call conventions: Call this operation in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. The ws-example, URL, certificate, and token in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameters of the public API operation, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API operation. The response example shows only the business data. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a persistent connection to wait for completion.

        GET /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning/credentials

        Response examples

        {
   "data": [
     {
       "credentialId": "credential-example",
       "status": "Enabled",
       "createTime": "<Upstream creation time>",
       "expireTime": "<Upstream expiration time>"
     }
   ]
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. Synchronous calls to the upstream service that fail may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret read failures as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling process. 400 InvalidParameter: The shared user pool is unavailable. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound: No corresponding binding exists. Upstream query failures cannot be replaced with an empty list, which may mislead users into repeatedly creating credentials.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        Used for configuration recovery and credential management: Existing plaintext tokens cannot be queried and retrieved again. The list provides only credential summaries. To obtain a new token, call CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential. To revoke a credential, submit the credentialId from the list to DeleteIdentityProviderSCIMCredential. A maximum of two credentials are allowed in the same pool. This operation returns the complete array and does not support or fabricate pagination parameters.

        指定者:
        listIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialsRequest
        返回:
        ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentialsResponse

      • listIdentityProviders

        public CompletableFuture<ListIdentityProvidersResponse> listIdentityProviders(ListIdentityProvidersRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        WAITING_CONFIGURATION also occupies the unique external identity provider quota for the workspace. CustomSSO (SAML/OIDC and SCIM) is mutually exclusive with DingTalk and Lark. SCIM reuses the CustomSSO binding and does not create a second identity provider. Creating other types returns 409 IdentityProviderAlreadyBound. You can change the binding only after unbinding and removing the existing binding. Returns the local binding summary without querying the actual SAML and SCIM configurations of AgentIdentity. If no binding exists, items is an empty array. Currently, a workspace supports only one external binding. The default value of maxResults is 10, and the valid values are 1 to 100. Currently, nextToken can only be omitted or left empty. A non-empty value returns InvalidParameter, and multi-page results cannot be fabricated. When CustomSSO initialization is complete but SAML metadata is not saved, the status is WAITING_CONFIGURATION. You can upload the configuration, which does not indicate that a background task is still running. After the configuration is saved, the status changes to UPDATING, and changes to READY after the task succeeds. To query SCIM independently, use GetIdentityProviderSCIM. The list does not issue tokens and does not return the vendor appSecret, encryptKey, or verificationToken.

        Requests and examples

        GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/identity-providers Call conventions: Call the API in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity provider resources of the workspace. The ws-example, URLs, certificates, and tokens in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request example shows the body parameters of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        GET /workspaces/ws-example/identity-providers?maxResults=10

        Response examples

        {
   "items": [
     {
       "workspaceId": "ws-example",
       "identityProviderType": "CustomSSO",
       "status": "WAITING_CONFIGURATION",
       "loginEnabled": false,
       "syncEnabled": false
     }
   ],
   "maxResults": 10,
   "totalCount": 1
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. A synchronous call failure to the upstream may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling. 400 InvalidParameter: maxResults is out of bounds or nextToken is non-empty, which is currently not supported. When a query fails, an error is displayed, and the status is not cleared to unconfigured.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        This API is used to discover the current binding. To query the specific SAML configuration of CustomSSO, use GetIdentityProvider. To query the SP address, use GetIdentityProviderServiceProvider. To query the actual SCIM configuration and independent operation results, use GetIdentityProviderSCIM.

        指定者:
        listIdentityProviders 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of ListIdentityProviders ListIdentityProvidersRequest
        返回:
        ListIdentityProvidersResponse

      • listImageCaches

        public CompletableFuture<ListImageCachesResponse> listImageCaches(ListImageCachesRequest request)
        description :

        Queries the logical image caches within the current account, region, and workspace. WorkspaceId is required, and caches are not visible across workspaces. All conditions filter the full set using the AND operator before pagination is calculated. Results are sorted in descending order of logical resource creation time and ascending order of ImageId. The cursor is bound to the account, region, workspace, all filters, and the sort order. Returns the complete cache objects, the AgentCount based on the configuration switch, and the actual deletion eligibility. Query failures do not return a disguised empty list, and the nextToken on the last page is an empty string.

      • prepareIdentityProviderSCIM

        public CompletableFuture<PrepareIdentityProviderSCIMResponse> prepareIdentityProviderSCIM(PrepareIdentityProviderSCIMRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        Requires an available CustomSSO shared user pool. Does not depend on SAML metadata and is not blocked by SAML updates or update failures. Synchronously calls AgentIdentity to enable SCIM receiving and reads the configuration and credential list. Reuses the existing configuration if receiving is already enabled. Repeated initialization does not create duplicate valid credentials or automatically enable user synchronization. If an enabled and unexpired credential exists, returns its summary and sets the token to null. If no available credentials exist, creates one and returns the token only for the current request. Existing invalid or expired credentials are not automatically deleted and may still count towards the upstream limit of two credentials. The prepare operation enables receiving and may issue credentials, but does not set the AC syncEnabled parameter, initiate the first import, or indicate that the external provisioning connection test has passed. After configuring the baseUrl and the current token in the external provisioning system, call UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM to confirm and enable synchronization. Existing tokens cannot be retrieved. If the response is lost, query the credential list first instead of automatically reissuing a token. Do not log tokens or persist them in frontend caches.

        Requests and examples

        POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning/prepare Call conventions: Call the API in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS token that has permissions on the identity source resources of the workspace. The ws-example, URL, certificate, and token in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameters of the public API, not the extra body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example shows only the business data. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not log the keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        POST /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning/prepare
 No business request body.

        Response example

        {
   "data": {
     "configuration": {
       "status": "Enabled",
       "baseUrl": "https://example.com/scim/v2"
     },
     "credential": {
       "credentialId": "credential-example",
       "status": "Enabled",
       "expireTime": "<Expiration time returned by the upstream>"
     },
     "token": "<Token newly issued only for this request; null if an available credential already exists>"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. Synchronous calls to the upstream may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable if they fail. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret read failures as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace not found errors follow the common error handling. 400 LimitExceeded.ScimCredential: The maximum of two credentials has been reached. You must explicitly delete one credential and try again. Credentials are not automatically deleted, rotated, or expanded. 400 InvalidParameter: The shared pool is unavailable. This call may have enabled upstream receiving and then reported an error due to issuance failure. The error does not mean that the operation has been automatically rolled back.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        The shared pool is created by using CreateIdentityProvider with identityProviderType set to CustomSSO. SAML configuration is not required. If an existing credential is reused and the token is null, use the token already saved by the user. Do not configure a null value in the external system. If the token is lost, call ListIdentityProviderSCIMCredentials to check first, and then explicitly call CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential to issue a new one. When the limit of two credentials is reached, the user must confirm and delete the unused one.

        指定者:
        prepareIdentityProviderSCIM 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM PrepareIdentityProviderSCIMRequest
        返回:
        PrepareIdentityProviderSCIMResponse

        Retries the image cache for the original ImageId in the current workspace. WorkspaceId is required. The business request body is not required and can be omitted or provided as an empty object. The source authorization and transfer network reuse the trusted context of the original registration. If a digest exists, the retry uses the original digest. If no digest exists, the original tag is resolved again. A new request for a FAILED status can start a new production round. PENDING and READY statuses are reused. DELETING status is rejected, and deleted resources are not recreated. PUBLIC and PRIVATE statuses reuse the pull authorization of the original workspace. Returns a complete acceptance snapshot and retains the original ImageId and CreatedAt. ClientToken does not guarantee request deduplication. If the result is not confirmed, query the real-time status first before deciding whether to resubmit.

      • updateCustomAgent

        public CompletableFuture<UpdateCustomAgentResponse> updateCustomAgent(UpdateCustomAgentRequest request)
        description :

        Provide at least one top-level field to update. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configurations. When providing a configuration object, specify its required subfields and include any optional configurations that you want to retain. Arrays are replaced as a whole. Pass an empty array [] to clear a list. The agenticFsMounts field does not accept null. Pass null for the description field to clear the description, and pass null for the healthCheck field to remove the health check. When updating an image, you must specify artifact.port and the type, instanceId, namespace, repo, and tag fields of artifact.container. To retain a custom startup command, also provide the entrypoint field. In code package pattern, specify artifact.port and the sourceUri, languageRuntime, and entrypoint fields of artifact.code. Do not specify the container field at the same time. Dependencies must be packaged by the user. ZIP and TAR.GZ formats are supported, and the compressed package size cannot exceed 500,000,000 bytes. Query the runtime environment identity by calling the ListAgentCodeRuntimes operation. The sourceUri field supports oss:// addresses or HTTPS object addresses of standard OSS public domain names, including signed URLs. For local files, first call the GetAgentCodePackageUploadUrl operation to obtain an upload URL, upload the file directly, and then commit the returned sourceUri. When submitting a new code package source, the backend rechecks read permissions, objects, and sizes. The configuration is saved only after the transfer succeeds. If the transfer fails, the current configuration is not saved. Saved fixed packages can be reused. Set the client timeout to 210 seconds for code package requests. Archive integrity and secure decompression are checked at startup. A successful acceptance does not indicate that the agent is ready to run. When providing the runtime field, the compute and sessionPolicy fields must be provided at the same time. If the hpa field or its subfields are omitted, unspecified elastic configurations use default values. To retain the original elastic configurations, provide them together. When providing the network field, omitted access items are treated as allowed, but actual access is still restricted by the workspace network configurations. To retain the original restrictions, provide both accessInternet and accessVpc. When providing the healthCheck field, the port field is required, and other unspecified items use default values. When providing the logging.sls field, both project and logstore must be specified. The update is an asynchronous process. A successful response indicates that the request is accepted. Call the GetCustomAgent operation to query latestSpecVersion, latestVersionStatus, and latestExecutionError, and check the status field to confirm the update result. The clientToken field currently does not provide idempotency guarantees. Do not rely on this parameter to prevent duplicate requests. The healthyThreshold field for health checks currently does not take effect. Omit this field.

        指定者:
        updateCustomAgent 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of UpdateCustomAgent UpdateCustomAgentRequest
        返回:
        UpdateCustomAgentResponse

      • updateIdentityProvider

        public CompletableFuture<UpdateIdentityProviderResponse> updateIdentityProvider(UpdateIdentityProviderRequest request)
        description :

        Prerequisites and update methods

        The workspace must be bound to an identity provider of the corresponding type. For DingTalk and Lark, you must submit at least one of loginEnabled, syncEnabled, metadata, and syncScope. protocol and saml are not accepted. For CustomSSO, use protocol, saml, and loginEnabled. metadata, syncEnabled, and syncScope are not accepted. The SCIM synchronization switch is managed separately through UpdateIdentityProviderSCIM.

        DingTalk and Lark

        The metadata is merged by field. Submit only the fields that need to be updated. Omitted fields and existing keys remain unchanged. Explicitly submitting null, empty strings, or blank strings will be rejected. The server validates the complete configuration after merging. When incremental synchronization is enabled, the merged configuration must include encryptKey and verificationToken. syncEnabled controls subsequent address book change events and does not control the initial synchronization or manual synchronization. syncScope applies only to DingTalk and Lark. If it is omitted or set to null, the current scope is retained. Saving the scope does not automatically trigger a full synchronization. To perform manual synchronization, call CreateIdentityProviderSyncJob after saving and waiting for the identity provider to be ready, and then call GetIdentityProviderSyncJob to query the task result.

        Custom SAML identity provider

        CustomSSO currently supports only SAML. The saml parameter supports two mutually exclusive methods: providing metadataXml, or providing the four manual configuration fields: entityId, loginUrl, bindingType, and x509Certificates. metadataXml is a single IdP EntityDescriptor XML text of up to 1 MiB, not a URL or file path. DTDs and external entities are prohibited. For manual configuration, entityId must be non-empty and up to 2,048 characters, and cannot be changed after saving. loginUrl must be an absolute HTTPS URL without user credentials and fragments. bindingType must be HTTP-Redirect or HTTP-POST. Certificates must be valid X.509 signing certificates, with a maximum of 10 certificates. jitProvisionEnabled controls the automatic creation of users during the initial logon, and jitUpdateEnabled controls whether user information is updated during logon. Omitting these switches during an update retains the existing values. Modifying only the JIT switches also requires an existing valid SAML configuration. Saving the SAML configuration does not automatically enable logon. A valid configuration must exist before enabling logon. Setting loginEnabled to false only triggers a shutdown of logon and does not delete the saved SAML or SCIM configurations.

        Asynchronous results and retries

        When actual changes exist, the expected configuration and the UPDATING status of the identity provider are returned. The CONFIGURED status may also be returned when resource configurations are restored. Call GetIdentityProvider to wait for the READY status. If the operation fails, check for statuses such as UPDATE_FAILED. If the configuration is identical and no restoration is required, the current binding may be returned directly without generating a new task. A successful HTTP request does not indicate that the background task or upstream configuration has taken effect. Operation conflicts occur when in-flight operations exist. If a submission times out, query the configuration and status before deciding whether to retry. The status parameter describes the status of the identity provider resource and logon configuration. The SCIM operation results for CustomSSO must be queried through GetIdentityProviderSCIM and cannot be inferred from this operation.

        指定者:
        updateIdentityProvider 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of UpdateIdentityProvider UpdateIdentityProviderRequest
        返回:
        UpdateIdentityProviderResponse

      • updateIdentityProviderSCIM

        public CompletableFuture<UpdateIdentityProviderSCIMResponse> updateIdentityProviderSCIM(UpdateIdentityProviderSCIMRequest request)
        description :

        Features and prerequisites

        The syncEnabled parameter is required. If you set this parameter to true, a task is submitted to independently enable SCIM and perform the initial full user import. During execution, the AgentIdentity receiving status must be Enabled, and an Enabled and unexpired credential must exist. Therefore, you must first call the prepare operation and complete the URL and token configuration in the external system. If you set this parameter to false, a task is submitted to disable synchronization and upstream receiving. Existing users, credentials, and SAML logon configurations are retained. If you re-enable the feature later and receiving is disabled, you must call the prepare operation again. After the request is accepted, the expected switch status in AC is saved and an independent SCIM task is submitted. The original shared binding fields are returned, and the status field still indicates the status of shared resources and logon configurations. The new scimStatus field indicates the independent SCIM status, and the operationStatus field indicates task result of the original SCIM task. The SCIM taskId is not returned. You can call GetIdentityProviderSCIM to query task result. The prerequisite checks for enabling the feature are executed within the task. If the prerequisites are not met, you may receive a successful request response first, and then the operationStatus becomes FAILED. A failure does not automatically roll back the expected switch status. SCIM does not depend on SAML configurations and does not affect the SAML status or switch. A successful task or a successful full import of empty users does not prove that continuous incremental synchronization is healthy. Whether users exist depends on whether the external system actually pre-provisions them. The scimStatus field indicates the independent SCIM configuration status. UNCONFIGURED: The preparation is not completed. WAITING_CONFIGURATION: The receiving end is enabled, the HTTPS URL is valid, and a valid token exists. The system is waiting for external configuration and enablement confirmation. UPDATING: The enablement or disablement is being executed. READY: Synchronization is enabled and the current enablement task is successful. The receiving end, URL, and credentials are still available. DISABLED: The feature is disabled and the configuration is retained. UPDATE_FAILED: The operation failed, was paused, was canceled, or the configuration and credentials became unavailable after enablement. The original facts of configuration, syncEnabled, and operationStatus are retained. The SAML or OIDC binding status is not used to determine the SCIM status. The READY status does not prove that Matrix execution is completed, the external connection test is passed, or continuous incremental synchronization is healthy.

        Requests and examples

        PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scim-provisioning Call conventions: Call the API in the region of the target workspace by using an AccessKey pair or STS credential that has permissions on the identity provider resources of the corresponding workspace. The ws-example, URL, certificate, and token in the following examples are placeholder values and must be replaced with actual values. The request body example represents the body parameters of the public API, not the additional body wrapper of the backend direct connection API. The response example shows only the business part. The outer layer also includes requestId, success, code, message, and httpStatusCode. Retain the requestId for troubleshooting and do not record keys. Asynchronous business tasks do not mean that the HTTP request uses a long connection to wait for completion.

        PUT /workspaces/ws-example/scim-provisioning
 {"syncEnabled": true}
 To disable the feature: {"syncEnabled": false}

        Response example

        {
   "data": {
     "workspaceId": "ws-example",
     "identityProviderType": "CustomSSO",
     "status": "READY",
     "loginEnabled": false,
     "scimStatus": "UPDATING",
     "syncEnabled": true,
     "operationStatus": "PENDING"
   }
 }

        Errors and handling

        Error handling: 400 InvalidParameter indicates that the parameters or current configuration prerequisites are not met. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound indicates that no binding of the matching type exists. A synchronous call failure to the upstream system may return 503 IdentityProviderProvisioningUnavailable. Retain the request ID for troubleshooting and do not interpret a read failure as unconfigured. Actual authentication and workspace non-existence errors follow the common error handling process. 400 InvalidParameter: The syncEnabled parameter is missing. 404 IdentityProviderNotFound: No CustomSSO binding exists. 409 IdentityProviderOperationConflict: The user pool is not ready, is being unbound, failed to unbind, or has a concurrent status conflict. If the upstream system is not enabled or has no valid credentials, it may manifest as an asynchronous FAILED status after acceptance. You cannot only handle HTTP errors.

        Call relationships and usage boundaries

        The call example for enabling the feature is body={"syncEnabled":true}, and for disabling the feature is body={"syncEnabled":false}. This API retains the original binding details and the meaning of the status field, and adds the scimStatus and operationStatus fields. After acceptance, call GetIdentityProviderSCIM to query the independent status and operationStatus. Pre-provisioning tests or user assignments for external IdPs must still be completed in the external system. AC does not configure external IdPs for users.

        返回:

      • updateModel

        public CompletableFuture<UpdateModelResponse> updateModel(UpdateModelRequest request)
        description :

        This operation supports updating description, contextSize, maxTokens, and capabilities. You must specify at least one non-null parameter. Parameters that are not specified or are set to null retain their original values. The capabilities parameter is replaced as a whole object. Capability fields that are not specified in the object are treated as false. Modifying only the description does not refresh the model configurations of associated agents. When contextSize, maxTokens, or capabilities actually change, the system asynchronously refreshes managed agents that reference the model within the same workspace, as well as external agents whose model source is PLATFORM. External agents whose model source is RUNTIME are not affected. Repeatedly submitting the same configuration does not trigger a new model configuration refresh. A successful response indicates that the model configuration has been saved, but does not indicate that associated agents have completed the configuration refresh or that the runtime has loaded the new configuration. You can call GetModel to query the saved model configuration.

      • validateAgentCodePackageFromOss

        public CompletableFuture<ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOssResponse> validateAgentCodePackageFromOss(ValidateAgentCodePackageFromOssRequest request)
        description :

        Uses the current workspace role to check whether the customer\"s OSS object exists and is readable, and checks the file name extension and compressed size. Returns the sourceUri, file name, size, and format read in this request. The bucket and object key are passed separately, and HTTPS download URLs are not accepted. The validation uses object metadata and read probing. It does not perform full downloads, transfers, or decompression, nor does it generate a SHA-256 hash. Passing the validation does not mean that the archive content is complete or can be started. When you submit a CreateCustomAgent or UpdateCustomAgent request, the system re-validates and transfers the package. You do not need to invoke this operation in advance as a prerequisite for submission.

      • verifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization

        public CompletableFuture<VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizationResponse> verifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization(VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizationRequest request)
        description :

        ACR and user OSS mounts share the workspace role. If no existing role is found, AliyunAgentCoreWorkspace-{workspaceId} is used. If a valid legacy OSS mount role exists, it is retained and only new permissions are appended without overwriting existing OSS policies. Fixed historical shared roles continue to be reused and are not recreated or renamed due to new naming templates. This operation performs a read-only check to verify whether the custom policies corresponding to the target instance, namespace, and repository are attached to the shared role, and checks the workspace prerequisites. It does not create execution versions or trigger configuration delivery. AUTHORIZED only indicates that the custom policy for the target name is attached, without parsing the policy content or simulating the final permissions. ELIGIBLE does not mean that RuntimeManager capacity or template admission is complete, nor does it require ACR configuration to be delivered. Creating or updating an agent re-verifies permissions and processes ACR dependencies on the backend. Configuration waiting, failures, and retries are reported through agent details.

        指定者:
        verifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorization VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizationRequest
        返回:
        VerifyWorkspaceAcrRamAuthorizationResponse

        description :

        Determines the shared role and target access point based on the workspace and server, checks whether the role has a mounted policy with the expected name and a type of Custom, and returns AUTHORIZED or UNAUTHORIZED. Consistent with OSS/ACR, this operation does not verify the policy body, role trust, or actual mount read/write permissions. If the upstream query fails, an error is returned.

      • verifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization

        public CompletableFuture<VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorizationResponse> verifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization(VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorizationRequest request)
        description :

        Queries whether the workspace OSS mount role is bound to the custom RAM policy corresponding to the target bucket, and returns AUTHORIZED or UNAUTHORIZED. When bucketName is not specified, the existing user-managed OSS binding of the workspace is used and the authorization status is saved. When bucketName is specified, only the authorization status of the specified bucket is queried without modifying the workspace OSS binding. This operation does not verify OSS data plane access permissions or resume workspace initialization tasks. Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR) and user OSS mounts share the workspace role. If no existing role is available, AliyunAgentCoreWorkspace-{workspaceId} is used. If a valid legacy OSS mount role exists, it is reused and permissions are only appended without overwriting existing OSS policies. Previously pinned shared roles continue to be reused and are not recreated or renamed due to new naming templates.

        指定者:
        verifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization 在接口中 AsyncClient
        参数:
        request - the request parameters of VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorization VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorizationRequest
        返回:
        VerifyWorkspaceOssMountRamAuthorizationResponse
